newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH C.BANK SAYS "NOT RUSHING" TO LOWER RATES.
newsitem.headline: CZECH C.BANK SAYS "NOT RUSHING" TO LOWER RATES.

text.p: Czech National Bank Executive Director Jiri Pospisil said on Thursday the bank was not rushing to lower interest rates, even though there was room to cut after a money supply growth slowed in 1996.
"The condiitons are being created for a reduction of interest rates, but we are not going to rush into it," Pospisil told a news conference.
